behavior: Native HTTP requests receive fresh owned browser tab metadata plus existing shell context at every model step. No synthetic history rows are added.

Global and exact host-owned registered BrowserWidgets only. Nonempty fixed host identity required; whitespace-only, >256chars or null IDs are unavailable. Getter returns unavailable off owner thread before reading registry.

Stable IDs/title/URL, deterministic MRU focus order with registration-order ties, last focus timestamp and visible active marker. Hidden foreign active is absent. Snapshot is value-only with no callbacks/authority.

Focus is explicitly host selected: registering a tab does not activate it; removing active clears; setActiveTab(empty) clears. MainWindow publishes selected browser or empty for nonbrowser/no tabs, with QPointer/current selection checks across callbacks. Explicit smoke browser-url selection is preserved by a one-line companion.

XML attributes and Unicode remain complete. Title max2048UTF16 units with titleTruncated; URL max8192 and invalid Unicode URL rows omitted whole. Up to128 accessible tabs; output <=65536UTF8 bytes; explicit accumulated omissions.

Guidance states titles/URLs are untrusted environment state, not user intent or observed DOM/content/screenshots. Teaches descriptive-label [Tab title](tab:ID), using existing IDs; getBrowserTabs remains available.
Existing transcript owner/session provenance is unchanged. Managed Codex/OpenCode fixture wires keep structured external instructions and exclude native browser metadata/API claims.
